what: A closed tank's hatch fumes and the odd case (release 2, behind the land battle's -TheaterLandHatchFumes; item 7 of the owner's film details, 26 November). Laid over battle-fx.json for that battle alone (FBattleEffects::LayOver). Closed tanks kept their spent cases inside; with her hatch open, every second or third shot by her count a faint wisp of fumes rises out of it (steam.hatch_fumes, the scene's Steam at her commander's place), and about one shot in eight, only when she is stopped, a crewman pitches a case out (ground_cases.tank, the scene's ThrowCase), as the Panther's crews threw empties from the turret's rear hatch and the T-34's to clear the fumes. Rare and small. Colours written to land (tools/battle-fx/game_curve.py write): the fumes 127,126,124 lands 132,130,127 and old 138,136,133 lands 148,146,142, at alpha 0.34 (the first cut, 147,145,142 at 0.16, moved the frame 4 levels at 30 m: unseen).

hatch_fumes._how: The burnt charge's fumes let out of an open hatch after the shot: a faint pale grey wisp rising a metre or two and gone; never a jet, never white steam.

tank._how: A tank gun's case pitched out of the hatch by hand: up and out to land beside her hull.
